name: Innerscene Free Parts Library (CC0 3D parts & CAD drawings)
summary: Browser library of ~5,150 3D parts (mechanical hardware, T-slot fittings, enclosures, furniture, props) and ~1,650 2D CAD drawings (DWG/DXF blocks, plan symbols, details), all released CC0 or US-government public domain. Preview in 3D in the browser, then download without an account.

access.license: CC0 1.0 (some parts US federal public domain)
access.notes: User-contributed under a CC0 contributor agreement, reviewed before listing; check each part page for its status. CC0 grants no trademark/patent rights. Files are kept 1-5 years. Optional AI generator uses your own API key.

procedure: Open https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library and pick 3D Parts or Drawings
Search or browse, open a part to rotate it in the 3D viewer
Click Download (e.g. GLB) on the part page; no signup

verdict.why: Real CC0 library: terms page read, sample part GLB downloaded (200, valid glTF), no signup. Docked: source post had no traction, contributions are user-uploaded so provenance per file relies on Innerscene review.
